name: Sampler tools
author: hundekraft
description: Three tools on the stock sampler screens, for a synth sampler sound and a sampled drum kit. They're there whenever the stock sampler screen shows; while op1r's sample editor is open, they step aside.
credits: Rebuilt by hundekraft from how Maiko Pruett's #249 and #250 work; none of Maiko's code is used
